sloka: स तथा शुशुभे श्रीमान् लतया कण्ठ सक्तया ।मालया इव बलाकानाम् ससंध्य इव तोयदः ॥४-१२-४१॥
transliteration: sa tathā śuśubhe śrīmān latayā kaṇṭha saktayā ।mālayā iva balākānām sasaṁdhya iva toyadaḥ ॥4-12-41॥

translations.english: With the creeper round the neck, Sugriva looked like the raincloud at twilight, adorned by a row of cranes like a garland.
